title: Uncapped Chooses AiPrise for US KYB
summary: Uncapped, which provides funding to e-commerce businesses, has chosen AiPrise to power its US KYB, including lien checks.
body_markdown:
[Uncapped](https://weareuncapped.com/?utm_source=aiprise&utm_medium=referral&utm_campaign=aiprise_case_study) , which provides funding to e-commerce businesses, has chosen AiPrise as its KYB partner. AiPrise now powers Uncapped's US KYB, including lien checks.


## Why Uncapped Chose AiPrise


Lending to a business starts with knowing exactly who you are lending to. Before capital goes out the door, Uncapped needs to confirm that a business is real, that it is in good standing, who owns and controls it, and whether its assets are already pledged to another lender. In the US, that information is spread across 50 state registries and separate lien filings, which makes it slow to piece together by hand.


AiPrise verifies businesses against primary sources across 200+ countries, drawing on 100+ data sources, and identifies and screens the owners behind each entity. For Uncapped, that means US business verification and lien checks on one platform and one integration, so every funding decision starts from the same verified picture. Our[guide to KYB in the US](https://www.aiprise.com/blog/best-kyb-solutions-us) covers why state-by-state registry fragmentation makes this harder than it looks.


E-commerce businesses need capital on their timeline, and lenders need certainty before they release it. Uncapped is building funding that keeps pace with the businesses it backs, and verifying every one of them properly is part of what makes that possible. We are glad to be the partner behind that.


Welcome to AiPrise, Uncapped.
